data_creator_info.evidence: We create news article category datasets using IndicCorp for 9 languages. The categories are determined from URL components.

datasets.notes: Categories include entertainment, sports, business, lifestyle, technology, politics, crime. Total 125,630 examples across 9 languages.

data_creator_info.evidence: We generate the dataset from our news article crawls which contain articles and their headlines. We ensure that the three incorrect candidates are not completely unrelated to the given article.

datasets.notes: 4-choice task: predict correct headline for a news article. Incorrect candidates chosen based on entity overlap. Total 880,311 examples.

data_creator_info.evidence: We use the open-source tool WikiExtractor to extract sections and their titles from Wikipedia. To make the task challenging, we choose the 3 incorrect candidates for a given section, only from the titles of other sections in the same article.

datasets.notes: 4-choice task: predict correct Wikipedia section title. Total 402,170 examples.

data_creator_info.evidence: The text is obtained from Wikipedia articles and the entities in the text are identified using Wikidata. We choose the 3 incorrect candidates from entities that occur in the same article and have the same type as the correct entity.

datasets.notes: Entity-masked cloze task from Wikipedia/Wikidata. Similar to Petroni et al. (2019). Total 238,897 examples.

data_creator_info.evidence: We use the WikiAnn NER dataset (Pan et al., 2017) which contains NER data for 282 languages. This dataset is created from Wikipedia by utilizing cross language links to propagate English named entity labels to other languages.

datasets.notes: Coarse-grained NER labels: Person (PER), Organisation (ORG), Location (LOC). Total 787,462 examples.

datasets.annotation_method: INSUFFICIENT_INFO: paper does not describe annotation method for this external dataset

data_creator_info.evidence: We use the CVIT-Mann Ki Baat dataset (Siripragrada et al., 2020) for this task.

datasets.notes: English-to-Indian language parallel sentences. Given a sentence in English, retrieve its translation from candidate sentences in an Indian language. Total 39,238 sentence pairs.

data_creator_info.evidence: We manually translated this dataset to 3 Indic languages (hi, mr, gu) with the help of skilled bilingual speakers. The annotators were paid 3 cents per word and the translations were then verified by an expert bilingual speaker.

datasets.source_reference: Levesque et al., 2011 (original WNLI); Wang et al., 2018 (GLUE)
